指令原文
Find all buildings that changed between T1 and T2 (newly built or demolished). Output a binary change mask.

展示备注：展示样例：从验证集挑选，标准见 results/agent_baseline/demo/README.md。

输入和参照

图像均为缩小展示；点击图像可放大。真值及所有 F1 仅供事后评估。

Agent 做了什么

按记录顺序回放。点卡片切步；← / → 切换。第 0 步是初始化。

The images show a dramatic change - T1 is mostly undeveloped land with some roads, while T2 shows a fully developed residential neighborhood with many houses. I need to segment buildings in both times and find the changes. Let me start by segmenting buildings in T2 (the later image with many buildings).

第 3 步

T1 has only 6 building instances with much smaller total area (10,119 vs 169,402 in T2). This confirms massive new construction. Now I need to find which T2 buildings are "new" (not present in T1) and which T1 buildings are "demolished" (not present in T2). Let me use match_instances to compare the two instance sets. I'll check both directions.
比较match_instances
调用参数
{
  "inst_t1": "inst#1",
  "inst_t2": "inst#0",
  "overlap_thr": 0.25
}
返回摘要 / 原文
{"ok":true,"appeared":"inst#2","appeared_n":162,"disappeared":"inst#3","disappeared_n":3,"present_t2":"inst#4","present_t2_n":3}

尚未产生掩码（未设置当前候选；工具的中间产物仍见上方返回）。

第 4 步

The match shows: - 162 buildings appeared (new in T2) - 3 buildings disappeared (demolished from T1) - 3 buildings are present in both times So the change mask should include: - All "appeared" buildings (inst#2) - newly constructed - All "disappeared" buildings (inst#3) - demolished Let me combine these into a single mask. First, let me convert inst#2 (appeared) to a mask.

  "sets": [
    "inst#2"
  ],
  "set_current": false
}
返回摘要 / 原文

尚未产生掩码（未设置当前候选；工具的中间产物仍见上方返回）。

Building change mask showing massive new residential development. T1 had only 6 small buildings on mostly undeveloped land; T2 shows a full suburban neighborhood with ~162 new houses plus a large commercial/white building complex. Removed false positive pond detection. Total 150 change components covering ~167k pixels of newly constructed buildings and a few demolished structures.

工具调用统计（含失败 / 跳过）：combine × 1（失败 / 跳过 0）；inspect × 2（失败 / 跳过 0）；match_instances × 1（失败 / 跳过 0）；remove_region × 1（失败 / 跳过 0）；segment_text × 2（失败 / 跳过 0）；submit × 1（失败 / 跳过 0）；to_mask × 2（失败 / 跳过 0）；view × 6（失败 / 跳过 0）

F1 由记录器算，Agent 全程看不到；真值也不参与规划。空真值且空预测的逐图 F1 按现有评测约定为 1。展示图为 JPEG 缩小版，面积及指标取原分辨率记录。
